Name: Cat to Furret (for Content Patcher)
Author: NanoBunTV
Description:
[b][size=4]A very basic mod that retextures the orange cat to Furret, and the gray cat to a Shiny Furret (Pink).[/size][/b]

After launching SMAPI once with the mod installed it will generate a config file where you can adjust which cat variants are retextured to Furret or Shiny Furret.

Extract the contents of the .zip file to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder with SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.

This mod will work perfectly fine with existing saves and can be removed without any issues.
